datasheet_identity.title: MM1Z2V0B THRU MM1Z75B SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The 5V6B curve was digitized directly from the vector trace in p.3 Fig. 1 at plotted current levels of 5, 10, 20, 30, and 40 mA; no table interpolation was used.
The p.2 VZ table provides minimum 5.49 V, nominal 5.6 V, and maximum 5.71 V at IZT = 5 mA. The nominal column is represented as source_kind typical because the strict schema has no nominal enum.

Reverse-bias quantities use the datasheet zener convention: positive zener voltage and zener current are across the reverse-biased device, with the cathode positive relative to the anode; p.1 states that the cathode line identifies the cathode end.
The breakdown voltage is the zener voltage at the paired test current IZT, not a separately inferred knee or absolute maximum rating.
No junction-capacitance value or reverse-recovery time is published in the supplied PDF.
omission_reason: The PDF publishes no capacitance or reverse-recovery specification, and it provides only one tabulated forward-voltage point; the reverse zener characteristic is available from the p.3 5V6B plot.
